---
title: "Priority lists"
description: "Make action order explicit and stop after an action succeeds."
---

```lua
local function Combat(spells)
  if spells.Cooldown:execute() then return true end
  if spells.Maintenance:execute() then return true end
  if spells.Primary:execute() then return true end
  return false
end
```

Run defensive, interrupt, and out-of-combat helpers before or beside your damage list only when their conditions are independent. Do not call `execute` on an optional spell without checking that its spell object exists.
